summary.text: Ann Rest is a Democratic-Farmer-Labor member of the Minnesota Senate for District 43.
The Senate member page says she was first elected to the House in 1984 and to the Senate in 2000, and she is in her eighth Senate term.
Her committee assignments include Taxes, Rules and Administration, and Commerce and Consumer Protection.

paragraphs.text: According to the page, Rest was re-elected to the House in 1986, 1988, 1990, 1992, 1994, 1996 and 1998.
She was re-elected to the Senate in 2002, 2006, 2010, 2012, 2016, 2020 and 2022.
